summary: P4: Drag-and-Drop Flight Reassignment UI - All tests passed. Backend API (16/16 tests) and Frontend UI verified working.

issues: React hydration warnings in console about span elements inside table elements (th, tr, td, tbody) - cosmetic issue, does not affect functionality

seed_data_creation: None - used existing 115 participants (40 students, 64 cadre, 11 staff)
context_for_next_testing_agent: P4 Flight Reassignment feature fully tested. All drag-and-drop functionality working. Flight Manager shows 7 columns (Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, Delta, Echo, Foxtrot, Unassigned). 104 manageable participants (students + cadre). Staff are correctly excluded from Flight Manager.

verified_features.feature: PUT /api/participants/{id}/assignment correctly updates flight and auto-maps squadron
verified_features.details: All 6 flight-squadron mappings verified: alpha/bravo -> 6th_cts, charlie/delta -> 21st_cts, echo/foxtrot -> 22nd_cts

verified_features.feature: PUT /api/participants/{id}/assignment validates flight names (rejects invalid flights)
verified_features.details: Invalid flight names return 400 Bad Request

verified_features.feature: Flight Manager toggle button (data-testid='flight-manager-toggle') visible on Roster page
Clicking Flights toggle shows 7 flight columns (Alpha, Bravo, Charlie, Delta, Echo, Foxtrot, Unassigned)
Each column shows correct student and cadre counts in header
verified_features.details: Headers show format like '6 stu • 1 cadre' with total count badge
Shows '44/104 assigned to flights' (104 manageable = students + cadre)

verified_features.feature: Search filter works in Flight Manager view
verified_features.details: Search input (data-testid='flight-manager-search') filters cards by name/CAPID

verified_features.feature: Dragging a participant card from one flight column to another triggers the API call and updates the view
verified_features.details: Successfully dragged 'Commander, Flight' from Alpha to Bravo. Toast notification shown. Counts updated correctly (Alpha: 7->6, Bravo: 9->10)

verified_features.feature: Students can be moved between flights
verified_features.details: basic_student participants can be reassigned via API

verified_features.feature: Cadre can be moved between flights
verified_features.details: cadre participants can be reassigned via API

verified_features.feature: Staff participants excluded from Flight Manager
verified_features.details: FlightManager only shows students and cadre (104 cards), not staff (11 participants)
Setting flight to empty string moves participant to Unassigned column
Invalid participant ID returns 404 Not Found
GET after PUT confirms flight and squadron changes are saved
